assets.name: 街头混混
assets.detail: Supine grey tank-top character: place the X on the visible front of the grey shirt across chest and upper abdomen. Preserve the head on the left, splayed arms and legs, and single hand wrap.
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: ONE transparent marked-state sprite for an existing isometric hand-painted RPG pawn.
Image 1 is the sole EDIT TARGET: 街头混混's existing defeated pawn. Image 2 is ONLY a reference for the brown packing-tape X marker used on the game's marked flour-sack pawn; do not copy the bag, bread, rope or its shape. Image 3 is the approved standing street-thug STYLE reference required by the project; do not copy its standing pose or checkerboard background.
Primary request: create the marked version of image 1 by adding ONLY TWO broad matte tan-brown packing-tape strips forming one clearly readable X on the upward-facing CLOTHING of the torso. Supine grey tank-top character: place the X on the visible front of the grey shirt across chest and upper abdomen. Preserve the head on the left, splayed arms and legs, and single hand wrap.
Marker: same warm kraft-brown tape color and clear dark-edged broad strips as image 2, gently torn ends, very sparse wear, adhering to clothing folds and local perspective. The X should occupy most of the visible shirt panel so it remains visible when the entire pawn is only about 90-110 pixels wide. It is a plain recovery marker, not a restraint: no bindings around limbs, no tape across the face or mouth, no wrapping the body, no extra accessories. No text, symbol printed on tape, label or flag.
Strict invariants: keep image 1's exact 1536 x 1024 canvas, camera, native orientation, figure placement, scale, silhouette, anatomy, pose, head size, face, clothing, shoes, all limbs, existing mild surface injuries and blood marks, thin grey oval pawn base and all its edges. Do not increase or remove existing injury detail; no new blood. The only visible modification is the two tape strips over the shirt. Do not recompose, rotate, mirror, crop, enlarge or shrink the figure; preserve the existing transparent margins and ground-contact position so unmarked and marked states align.
Preserve the approved bold dark outlines, broad hand-painted light/shadow facets, upper-left light and selective detail. Keep the original pawn base, but no floor tile, scene, cast ground shadow or additional objects. Genuine alpha-transparent background, no painted checkerboard or solid background. Return only this single complete marked pawn.
